intelligence.human_view: Think of it like a menu. One big board with everything on it looks fine on your phone, but on a laptop there's a big empty space underneath it — half the board is air. Three smaller boards side by side, each explaining one thing, fill the space nicely on a laptop and stack beautifully on a phone. And if you want a picture instead of words on any board, you just tap it and swap it — picture, video, whatever you like. The header folds away after a few seconds so everything fits — he saw it work himself.
intelligence.simple_view: Three boards of words instead of one big board! One big board leaves a big empty space on a laptop! Three boards fill the space nicely — on a laptop AND on a phone! And you can tap any board and swap it for a picture or a video!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — three boards of words instead of one big board, dear! One big board leaves a big empty space on a laptop! Three boards fill the space nicely, love — on a laptop AND on a phone! And you can tap any board, dear, and swap it for a picture or a video!
intelligence.naya_view: Build About, Skills, and Memberships as three text boards per slide. Three boards explain each thing, in thirds, with room for the text to display nicely. Never a single big board: it leaves a big empty space underneath on a laptop, and a standard that works on mobile but not on laptop is not a standard. Make every board tap-to-swap: a member clicks any board and swaps it for an image or a video. Keep the header fold-away — he confirmed it working with his own eye: after a few seconds the header scrolls away and everything fits. Do not apply this to the School: the School keeps image-in-the-middle with two text boards.
